summary.text: Luke Clippinger is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 46 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is on the November ballot with fellow incumbents Mark Edelson and Robbyn Lewis and Jeremy Amason for the district's three seats.
An attorney, he serves on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee and the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Luke Clippinger was born in Baltimore and graduated from Baltimore Polytechnic Institute in 1990.
He earned a B.A. in politics from Earlham College in 1994 and a J.D. from the University of Louisville's Louis D. Brandeis School of Law in 2005.
Clippinger was district director for U.S. Representative Baron Hill of Indiana from 1998 to 2005 and campaign manager for Tom Perez's 2006 campaign for Attorney General.
His legislative biography lists him as an assistant state's attorney for Anne Arundel County from 2007 and as an elder at Brown Memorial Presbyterian Church in Baltimore.
Clippinger assumed office on January 12, 2011, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly website lists him on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee and the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.
